يمتلكون (form VIII)
# يَمْتَلِكُونَ (yamtalikūna) /jam.ta.li.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# يُمْتَلَكُونَ (yumtalakūna) /jum.ta.la.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
